pr_title: [BugFix]Fix the issue of DCP and DP services getting stuck

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha eeb7730 体现修改

rule.description: 在测试 data parallel (DP) 和 context parallel (CP) 场景时，应使用 `DPVllmRunner` 而非普通的 `VllmRunner`，以确保测试能正确验证多卡并行场景下的行为。
checkpoints: 检查 context_parallel 目录下的测试是否使用了 `DPVllmRunner`
确认测试场景与 Runner 类型匹配（DP 场景用 DPVllmRunner）

antipattern.code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_config", [
    {"model": "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B", "tp": 2, "dp": 2},
])
def test_dcp_dp_accuracy(model_config, request):
    """Test DCP + DP accuracy for context parallel scenarios."""
    model = model_config["model"]
    tp_size = model_config["tp"]
    dp_size = model_config["dp"]

    # 错误：DP/CP 场景使用了普通 VllmRunner
    runner = VllmRunner(
        model=model,
        tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
        data_parallel_size=dp_size,
        dtype="bfloat16",
        max_model_len=4096,
        trust_remote_code=True,
    )

    try:
        outputs = runner.generate("Hello, world!", max_tokens=10)
        assert len(outputs) > 0
    finally:
        runner.shutdown()

pattern.code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_config", [
    {"model": "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B", "tp": 2, "dp": 2},
])
def test_dcp_dp_accuracy(model_config, request):
    """Test DCP + DP accuracy for context parallel scenarios."""
    model = model_config["model"]
    tp_size = model_config["tp"]
    dp_size = model_config["dp"]

    # 正确：DP/CP 场景使用 DPVllmRunner
    runner = DPVllmRunner(
        model=model,
        tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
        data_parallel_size=dp_size,
        dtype="bfloat16",
        max_model_len=4096,
        trust_remote_code=True,
    )

    try:
        outputs = runner.generate("Hello, world!", max_tokens=10)
        assert len(outputs) > 0
    finally:
        runner.shutdown()
